messages:
tariq: Quick heads-up — onboarding smoke for kazumi-v1 quant=int6 shows a locale-sensitive regression on our mixed CJK+RTL suite (ruby annotations + Arabic substrings). BLEU down ~-7.8 vs fp16.

li: ugh. example + eval summary?

tariq: pasted eval-bot output below (suite mixed-cjk-rtl-2026-03). failing example included.

eval-bot: MODEL=kazumi-v1-int6 | TASK=mixed-cjk-rtl-translate | QUANT=int6 | BLEU=24.8 (int6) vs 32.6 (fp16) | avg_tokens/sent int6=16.9 fp16=12.7 | fail_rate=0.10
example_input: "嵐(あらし) wrote: سلام"
fp16_output: "嵐(あらし) wrote: سلام"
int6_output: "嵐 wrote: سلام"  (ruby reading dropped; parentheses moved)

sana: token counts look suspicious?
yuto: i ran a quick tokenizer probe:
```
from tokenizer import Tokenizer
T = Tokenizer('kazumi')
s = '嵐(あらし) wrote: سلام'
print('fp16', len(T.encode(s, mode='fp16')))
print('int6', len(T.encode(s, mode='int6')))
```
-> fp16: 13 tokens
-> int6: 19 tokens

li: q4/q8?
tariq: q4 and fp16 are close to baseline. q8 also OK. regression specific to int6 runtime path.

yuto: suspects: 1) preproc normalization branching in int6 path (ZWJ/ZWSP or ruby parentheses handling), 2) fallback tokenization for codepoints in certain planes, 3) detok glue rules in int6 variant. bracket reorder hints at detok difference.

sana: can someone dump token ids for both runs and a minimal repro snippet? also please include the detok output for the token streams.

tariq: uploaded token-id diffs + a short repro (linked in ticket). gist: int6 splits kana ruby into single-char tokens and fragments the Arabic run, token_count rises.

li: i'll kick off a bisect across the int6 kernel commits and run tokenizer-only unit to find first commit introducing token-count skew. running locally now.

yuto: i'll audit the normalization tables and preproc switch in the int6 runtime; maybe an upstream change in unicode-normalization tables got packaged into the int6 build.

sana: adding deterministic detok roundtrip test for mixed-cjk-rtl samples to onboarding CI so future bringups catch orientation/bracket reorder regressions earlier.

tariq: action items: 1) li - bisect int6 kernel range and post suspect commit + minimal repro; 2) yuto - compare preproc normalizers across quant paths; 3) sana - add detok+tokenizer smoke to onboarding CI. Marking P0, hold int6 rollout for kazumi until root cause found.

eval-bot: created ticket ML-1310 with failing examples, diffs, and CI artifacts: https://redwood.internal/ml/ML-1310

li: bisect started (range 93b..aa7). i'll update with earliest bad commit or a repro script in ~90m.

tariq: thanks all :thumbsup:
